name: Storm-Wrought Chains

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains

disable: DC 25 Thievery check (expert) to release the lock, or DC 25 Arcana check or DC 25 Nature check (expert) to harmlessly release the storm's energy

items.name: Storm's Rage
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to break or escape the chains

---

Effect The chains release a devastating blast of lightning that deals 4d8+14 electricity damage to all creatures in the room. Affected creatures must each attempt a DC 24 Fortitude save save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Deafened for 1 minute.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes deafened for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes deafened for 8 hours.

text: Brightly polished copper chains rumble with distant thunder and statically charge the air.
